features.name: top_bar_on
features.description: Numeric on/off indicator for the top LED bar encoded by attribute_1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps the top-bar state in a numeric scale suitable for SVM margins.

features.name: upper_left_bar_on
features.description: Numeric on/off indicator for the upper-left LED bar encoded by attribute_2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves upper-left illumination as a direct linear input.

features.name: upper_right_bar_on
features.description: Numeric on/off indicator for the upper-right LED bar encoded by attribute_3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves upper-right illumination as a direct linear input.

features.name: middle_bar_on
features.description: Numeric on/off indicator for the middle LED bar encoded by attribute_4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes the central split of the glyph directly available to the margin.

features.name: lower_left_bar_on
features.description: Numeric on/off indicator for the lower-left LED bar encoded by attribute_5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves lower-left illumination, a sparse but informative segment state.

features.name: lower_right_bar_on
features.description: Numeric on/off indicator for the lower-right LED bar encoded by attribute_6.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves lower-right illumination, a frequent anchor segment for linear separation.

features.name: bottom_bar_on
features.description: Numeric on/off indicator for the bottom LED bar encoded by attribute_7.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps bottom-bar evidence in a normalized numeric form.

features.name: lit_segment_fraction
features.description: Fraction of the seven LED segments that are on in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a smooth density axis for linear margins, separating sparse from heavily illuminated patterns.
features.formula: (np.where(((attribute_1 == 1) | (attribute_1 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_2 == 1) | (attribute_2 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_3 == 1) | (attribute_3 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_4 == 1) | (attribute_4 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_5 == 1) | (attribute_5 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_6 == 1) | (attribute_6 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_7 == 1) | (attribute_7 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)) / 7.0

features.name: complete_side_pair_fraction
features.description: Fraction of left and right vertical side pairs where both the upper and lower bars are on.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a low-order interaction for vertical continuity that a purely linear use of raw bits would not express directly.

features.name: outer_loop_strength
features.description: Interaction score for an outer-loop outline based on top, bottom, and side-bar illumination.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes closed-outline strength as a normalized composite useful for linear margins.

features.name: glyph_plausibility_judgment
features.description: Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how coherent and readable the on/off LED glyph appears under ordinary seven-segment display conventions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects a smooth readability prior that can stabilize decisions when one segment is noisy.

features.name: glyph_ambiguity_judgment
features.description: Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 estimating visual ambiguity among plausible seven-segment glyph interpretations; high values mean multiple readings seem similarly plausible.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a continuous uncertainty cue for rows near more than one valid-looking glyph, helping a linear SVM place less brittle margins.
